content_of_post_to_comment:
To clarify: one of the comforts of doomscrolling is that I can stop it at any time, even after just 1 minute. I don't have to commit an extensive amount of time for it, like committing 20 mins to watch a TV show, or committing an hour to play video games or to read a book.

So what's a good replacement activity that I can start and stop any time, whether it's after 1 minute, or after 3 hours?
comment: I found that the problem with a lot of replacements is they feel like a commitment, which makes them harder to start. Things like sketching, walking without a destination, cleaning one small area, or reading random articles work because you can quit instantly without feeling like you wasted anything. The “I can stop after 1 minute” rule might actually be the thing worth preserving.
